test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT about the Deccan Plateau?

options.text: The Satpura Range is in the South of the Plateau.
The Eastern Ghats are in the East of the plateau.
The Western Ghats are in the West of the Plateau.
The Vindhya Range is in the North of the Plateau.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Satpura Range is in the South of the Plateau.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Deccan Plateau:-**

 
 
• It is a large plateau in southern India, covering most of the southern part of the country.
 
• **It is bordered by the Eastern Ghats to the east, the Western Ghats to the west, the Satpura Range to the north, and the Nilgiri Hills to the south.**
